claims: Siena College is officially Siena University.
Siena College is a private Franciscan liberal arts college.
Siena College is located in Loudonville, New York.
Loudonville, New York is a suburb about 10 minutes north of Albany.
Siena College is situated in the Capital Region.
Siena College's campus is in the Town of Colonie.
Siena College's address is 515 Loudon Rd, Loudonville, NY 12211.
Siena College is in the Capital District/Hudson Valley, New York.
Siena College is approximately 2.5 hours north of New York City.
Siena College is 3 hours west of Boston.
Siena College is a 43-major institution, according to Wikipedia.
Siena College's sports teams are the Siena Saints and compete in NCAA Division I, according to Wikipedia.
